purpose: Non-statistical edit demonstrations on a shared page; no timing, token or line-count metric.

initial_trials.status: superseded; inherited prepare assertion is not executable

assignments.group_intro: Wrap the existing heading and escaped notice in one section; component lane may extract a reusable ordinary typed helper, tree lane uses a literal section. Preserve controls, routes, publication branches and errors.
assignments.move_publication: Place publication immediately before the edit form as a body sibling. Start each variant independently from its input sample.

agent_constraints: No validation, repair, formatting, builds, consultations or commits. Root performs independent full checking/emission and exact markup observation.
root_shared_support_adjustments: Remove exported post_form declaration with invalid opaque-input assertion fixture.
Replace each inherited post_form call with literal make_tag(form) and element using the same prepared attrs/controls.
Remove html::invalid_url from the inner layout bound because its operations emit only html::invalid_structure.
repair_boundary: Grouping helper/section structure and sibling-order target edits were retained. Corrected pre-repair raw files were not separately captured; the resulting files and source snapshots record the bounded repair recipe, not byte-for-byte proof of unassisted first-pass success.
limitations: One agent per surface and two tasks; grouping exercises helper extraction in one lane but literal grouping in the other. No statistical generalization or extraction parity.
